summary: Record the provider outcome before publishing its terminal harness event

replay.detail: No replay cursor or spool format changes. The existing terminal event remains unacknowledged until the provider result reaches the existing exit-report path.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, migrations or schema versions change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: Native drivers preserve the actual provider success or failure when the wrapper terminal receipt precedes task completion. Mailbox admission and fencing remain unchanged; foreign runtime, invocation and token rejection still terminate the driver.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart or startup work is added. Operations deploys the normal binary update.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual action is required.

recovery.detail: No graph recovery or repair is required. This corrects a reproduced completion-order failure; historical CI stale-mailbox failures remain unattributed.
